title: Garlicky Shrimp Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and quick stir-fry made with garlicky flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is actually vegan, using marinated tofu instead of shrimp.

ingredients.name: Marinated Tofu
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade marinated tofu

ingredients.name: Garlicky Sauce
ingredients.notes: Make your own sauce with equal parts soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of warmth to the dish

ingredients.name: Greek Skillet Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add a Mediterranean twist to the dish

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the marinated tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Add the garlicky sauce, cinnamon, and Greek Skillet Seasoning to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
